notes.title: Play Cubers: Arena NOW!
notes.notes:
This is it! Slash, smash, summon and bounce your way to freedom now on PC! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/862700/ss_432fc9c17bb77a9d10f71812735798490fe6fecf.1920x1080.jpg?t=1595919499[/img]

Take advantage of the 15% launch discount and let's fight! 

Feel free to leave a review once you try the game :) If you would like to get in touch with our support, please send us a message to support@teyon.com. We will do our best to fix any issues!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Cubers: Arena will be released next week!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone! 

It took some time to pass a certification process on all platforms, but we can finally announce that Cubers: Arena is now ready to be released! The game will be out on Steam next Tuesday, July 28th and will be offered for €/$14.99. You can also enjoy a launch discount of 15% for the first week of sales!

Check out what awaits on you in Cubers: Arena in the Launch Gameplay Trailer below:

[previewyoutube=uEBSuFMbWY4;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]











Stay tuned! Thank you for your support!
